source: U.S. CDC/NCHS National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey
cohort: Age 18 years and older; positive fasting subsample weight required.

target.meaning: Reported ever told by a doctor/health professional that respondent had hypertension

missing_values: No imputation in development dataset; remove rows missing any required feature, target, survey design field, or positive WTSAF2YR. Report source missingness before filtering.

invalid_values.age: Require age 18 through 80; NHANES public file top-codes age at 80.
invalid_values.bmi: Require finite BMI > 0; preserve valid extremes and report IQR outliers rather than deleting statistical outliers.
invalid_values.systolic_bp: Use mean of available readings that are >0 and <=300 mmHg; NHANES capture rule says SBP cannot exceed 300.
invalid_values.fasting_glucose: Require finite fasting glucose >0 and positive WTSAF2YR.
invalid_values.target: Only raw codes 1 and 2 are labeled; 7/9/missing excluded.

model_training: Not performed. No classifier or prediction model is fit by this workflow.
interpretation: BPQ020 is reported ever-diagnosed hypertension history, not future hypertension prediction, not medical diagnosis, and not clinically validated.
